# Other model families on the main horizons: validation period (generated by `scripts/analyze_completion.py`; completion batch, parts P3)

LightGBM (S4, scenario A) at 1, 6, 24, 48, 72 and 168 h; GRU, TCN and a patched Transformer (LSTM L4 inputs and training procedure) at 1 h and 24 h; same samples as the XGBoost and LSTM models of each horizon. Tuning budgets differ: XGBoost 90 trials per horizon (30 at 72 and 168 h), LSTM 12 (+78 in the equal-budget LSTM) per horizon, LightGBM 30, GRU/TCN/Transformer 12. Differences are model minus reference in MAE (MW), 95% moving-block bootstrap (168-hour blocks); negative = the new model is better; an interval that includes zero is not distinguishable. Validation predictions (optimistic).

| horizon | model | MAE (MW) | vs XGBoost S4 (MW, 95% CI) | vs LSTM L4 (MW, 95% CI) | vs ridge (MW, 95% CI) |
|---:|---|---:|---|---|---|

## Caveats

- One test year per horizon; tuning budgets differ (stated above); GRU, TCN and the Transformer were evaluated at 1 h, 24 h and the day-ahead task only, after a cost amendment of the protocol (2026-10-20).
- The TCN pools the hourly input to 3-hour steps and the Transformer uses 6-hour patches (cost reasons); they are not the architectures of the original papers.
- LightGBM uses the same feature set S4 as XGBoost, so differences mostly reflect the learning algorithm and the tuning budget.
